cases.question: Who requested the collaboration for updating the new PPC of the Computer Science Bachelor's course and what was his role?
cases.expected_answer: Prof. Pablo Mayckon Silva Farias requested the collaboration for updating the new PPC of the Computer Science Bachelor's course. He is the coordinator.

evidence.quote: Pablo, na qualidade de coordenador, informou a todos que gostaria que, se possível, o Colegiado aprovasse as novas ementas, bibliografias e o novo PPC na próxima reunião do Departamento em março.

cases.question: What was the value of the research grant for the project 'FRDI - Financial Reconciliation Dell Service Provider Invoicing - PHASE II' and which professor coordinated it?
cases.expected_answer: The value of the research grant for the project 'FRDI - Financial Reconciliation Dell Service Provider Invoicing - PHASE II' was R$ 1,584,541.06, and it was coordinated by Prof. Rossana Andrade.

evidence.quote: Termo Aditivo do Projeto intitulado: ' FRDI - Financial Reconciliation Dell Service Provider Invoicing - PHASE II ', celebrado entre a UFC e a DELL Computadores do Brasil Ltda, sob a coordenação da Profa. Rossana Andrade, cujo objetivo é a prorrogação por um mês do prazo de vigência do projeto de 31/01/2022 para 28/02/2022, bem como a alteração no orçamento de R$ 1.463.417,87 para R$ 1.584.541,06 (total do aditivo de R$ 121.123,19).
